sentences.text:
Page 1 of 3
 Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No. 14379 of 2010

This petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India, seeking the following relief:
".. to issue an appropriate Writ, order or direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring action of the respondents in constructing pucca drainage system with pucca cement manholes over the land admeasuring half acre in Sy.No.244 and 245 at Aushapur village of Ghatkesar Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, without initiating Land Acquisition Proceedings and also without making compensation to the petitioner as illegal, unlawful, contrary to law and against the ARtricle-300-A of Constitution of India and consequently to direct the respondents to initiate Land Acquisition Proceedings and pay the compensation in respect of the land of the petitoner ....."
2.
Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.

The learned Standing Counsel for National Highways Authorities, submitted that at the time of admission this Court granted interim orders directing the respondents not to interfering with the possession of the petitioner's land in Sy.No.244 and 245 of Aushapur village of Ghatkesar Mandal without following due process of law and since then the respondents are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner's land.
4. Even after lapse of more than thirteen years the respondents did not chose to file the counter or vacate petition denying the averments of the petition.
5.
In view of the same, this writ petition is disposed of, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject land without following due process of law.

However, if the respondents wanted to take the SK,J land of the petitioner, the respondents are directed to follow the procedure as per Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Act, 2013.
